clues.text: In Eden, God told her He would sharply increase her pain in childbirth.
She bore Cain and said that with the help of the LORD she had brought forth a man.
She later gave birth to Cain's brother, who was a keeper of sheep.
In Eden, the LORD God made her from a rib taken from the man, then brought her to him.
Paul feared the Corinthians might be led astray, just as she was deceived by the serpent's cunning.
In the garden, she saw the tree was pleasing to the eyes, ate its fruit, and gave some to her husband.
God cursed the ground because Adam listened to her voice and ate from the forbidden tree.
